goal:
Create a new daemon: mcp_directory_ingestor.py that scrapes 4 MCP directories not currently covered, seeding mcp_discovery_candidates with fresh servers.

Directories to scrape (in order of reliability):

1. PulseMCP API: GET https://api.pulsemcp.com/v0beta/servers?limit=100&offset=0 (paginate via offset). Fields: name, url, github_url, description. Map to candidate_name=name, candidate_url=github_url or url.

2. Glama.ai: GET https://glama.ai/api/mcp/v1/servers?first=100&after=<cursor> (GraphQL or REST). Fields: name, repositoryUrl, description.

3. mcp.so: GET https://mcp.so/api/servers (if available) or scrape https://mcp.so/servers page list. Parse server cards for name + repo URL.

4. Smithery.ai: GET https://smithery.ai/api/v1/servers?q=&limit=100&offset=0. Fields: qualifiedName, displayName, deploymentUrl.

For each source:
- Paginate fully until no more results
- INSERT INTO mcp_discovery_candidates (candidate_name, candidate_url, candidate_description, discovered_in_directory=<source_name>, discovered_status='active', promoted=false, first_seen=now(), last_seen=now()) ON CONFLICT(candidate_url) DO UPDATE SET last_seen=now()
- Log: source, pages fetched, new candidates inserted, skipped (already known)

Run cycle every 24h. On startup always run immediately.
Send heartbeat to service_health every 60s.
Target: 5000+ new unique candidates across all 4 sources.
constraints: Graceful error handling per source -- one source failing must not stop others
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING or DO UPDATE last_seen
success_criteria: Daemon starts and runs all 4 sources
mcp_discovery_candidates grows by 1000+ on first run
Errors on one source don't crash daemon
